parameters.question: Apply CCA to find linear relationships between two sets of variables (X and Y), computing min(n_vars_X, n_vars_Y) canonical components, and report the canonical correlations. Canonical correlation values per component must match the reference within +/-1e-3 (absolute); column order and label naming may differ. Match components by their order (component 1, 2, ...; correlations typically sorted in descending order).
